title: 2.1.12 Challenges — Optional Stretch
description: Pick one or more of the stretch challenges and implement them in the editor. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Pick a challenge (or more)
steps.instructions:
Read the full list in `content.md` (the ⭐ Challenges page). Six options, varying difficulty:

1. **Color-changing sprite** (easy) — cycle sprite color on each arrow-key press.
2. **Orbiting companion** (medium) — second sprite circles the player using `sin`/`cos`.
3. **DevTools exploration** (hard) — inspect `player` in the browser console.
4. **HUD with multiple values** (medium) — frameCount, player pos, fps on-screen.
5. **Trail effect** (medium) — sprite leaves fading trail.
6. **Mouse-follower with lerp** (hard) — smooth cursor-chasing sprite.

You're not required to attempt all six — pick what interests you.
hints: Even completing one challenge passes the auto-grader.
Read the hints in each challenge on the content page.

steps.title: Build in the editor
steps.instructions:
Start from the provided `script.js` template. Delete the comments and write your own code. You need:

- A canvas (`new Canvas(400, 400)`)
- At least one sprite
- Some interactivity OR animation OR inspection beyond a static sprite
hints: Keep velocity numbers small — 2 to 6 is plenty.

steps.title: Use at least one advanced feature
steps.instructions:
Your code must use ONE of these techniques (more is fine):

- `kb.presses(...)` — edge-triggered input (used in color-cycling)
- `sin(...)` or `cos(...)` — circular/oscillating motion
- `mouse.x` / `mouse.y` — mouse position
- `lerp(...)` — smooth interpolation
- `frameCount` with modulo — timed events
- `text(...)` + `textSize(...)` — on-screen HUD
hints: The auto-grader checks for ANY of the above — pick whichever suits your challenge.

requirements.title: Create at least one sprite
